input: A family with a five-year-old proposes Baga, Dudhsagar and Old Goa on 19 December. They do not mention a falls reservation.
A traveler wants to put down a deposit today. The package says breakfast is included and cancellation is free, with no deadline.
A traveler lands at Heathrow at 11:15 and departs from Gatwick at 15:00 on a separate ticket with checked bags.

An overnight train is waitlisted in the traveler’s note. There is a separately booked morning transfer after scheduled arrival. Correction from the traveler or operator: The traveler supplies a fresh confirmation for that exact train and date.
“Delhi se Goa 18 Dec, hotel North Goa, return abhi decide nahi.” A pasted attachment also shows “19/12” with no label.
